title: Which pairs of primes below 20 have a sum that is a multiple of 5?
description: The primes below twenty are taken from the list and tried in pairs, and each sum is checked against the multiples of five. Three pairs are picked out.
teaching_notes: One idea: pick two primes from the list, add them, and keep the pair when the sum is a multiple of five. Watch for students who forget that two is a prime and so leave out the pairs that contain two.

video_script.why: The child reads the primes below twenty from the sieve list, tries pairs and tests each sum against the multiples of five.
video_script.substitution: Add two primes from the list and check whether the sum is a multiple of five.
video_script.anchor: The primes below 20 on cards, with a number line of the multiples of 5 below them
video_script.payoff_line: Two and three, three and seven, and two and thirteen are the three pairs. Each sum is a multiple of five.

final_answer.spoken: three pairs have sums that are multiples of five

maths_rules: 2 + 5 = 7 is not a multiple of 5, so the pair 2 and 5 is rejected
other pairs also work, such as 7 + 13 = 20 and 3 + 17 = 20
video_script.design: Prime cards are paired on the board and each sum is placed on a line of multiples of five; a sum that lands on a multiple stays teal and one that misses is crossed out.

beats.on_screen: title card From your book; cards of the primes below 20; a line of the multiples of 5

marks.cards: the cards of the primes below twenty appear
marks.ask: a line of the multiples of five appears below the cards

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This is a question from your book about prime pairs.
<bookmark mark='cards'/>Take the prime numbers below twenty and pair them up.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>Find three pairs whose sum is a multiple of five.

beats.on_screen: the cards and the line of multiples stay on the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

beats.on_screen: multiples of 5: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25; read the primes from the list made by circling

marks.mult: the multiples of five light up on the line
marks.list: the list of primes made by circling is shown

narration: <bookmark mark='mult'/>The multiples of five are five, ten, fifteen, twenty and so on.
<bookmark mark='list'/>We read the primes from the list that the circling and crossing out gave us.

marks.given: the eight primes are written in a row

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the eight primes below twenty.

beats.on_screen: To find: three pairs whose sum is a multiple of 5

marks.find: the words to find are written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find three pairs whose sum is a multiple of five.

marks.first: two and three are added and the sum five lands on the line
marks.miss: two and five are added and the sum seven misses the line

narration: <bookmark mark='first'/>Step one, start with the smallest primes. Two plus three is five, which is a multiple of five.
<bookmark mark='miss'/>Two plus five is seven, which is not, so that pair is left out.

marks.ten: three and seven are added and the sum ten lands on the line
marks.fifteen: two and thirteen are added and the sum fifteen lands on the line

narration: <bookmark mark='ten'/>Step two, try more pairs. Three plus seven is ten, a multiple of five.
<bookmark mark='fifteen'/>Two plus thirteen is fifteen, which is also a multiple of five.

beats.on_screen: Check: 5, 10, 15 are multiples of 5; 2, 3, 7, 13 are all primes below 20; other pairs such as 7 + 13 = 20 also work

marks.ok: the three sums are matched with the multiples of five
marks.more: the extra pair seven and thirteen is shown

narration: <bookmark mark='ok'/>Step three, check the pairs. The sums five, ten and fifteen are multiples of five. Every number used is a prime below twenty.
<bookmark mark='more'/>Other pairs work as well, such as seven and thirteen.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>Two and three, three and seven, and two and thirteen are the three pairs. Each sum is a multiple of five.
